verdict.rationale: Weave clearly documents offline evaluations: an Evaluation object takes a Dataset plus scorers and runs against repeatable test cases with comparisons. Curating datasets from production traces is only implied, by a marketing claim that you can test models against production traces; there is no documented workflow for turning traces into a versioned dataset. Missing for 10: documented trace-to-dataset curation workflow (selecting or filtering production calls into a Dataset), dataset versioning and editing details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can curate datasets from production traces and run offline evaluations against them

citations.quote: the core of the workflow is the _`Evaluation` object_, which defines: A `Dataset` or list of dictionaries for test examples. One or more scoring functions.
measure your LLM application’s performance against repeatable test cases, compare changes over time, and identify regressions
You can test new LLMs and custom models against production traces, assessing their performance for your specific use cases.
